posts.title: Good work
posts.description: We had a crew come and clean air conditioners the other day. Professional, efficient, polite, focussed. These guys were doing something of great help to their customers. Business was growing, and it was clear that they took pride in doing it right. No talk about AI, no talk about grandstanding on LinkedIn, no having to sound like someone or something. posts.title: Sports Day
posts.description: Good energy on a sunny day There was sports day at school yesterday. It is a day where all the classes of each year show off a dance, gymnastics or compete in athletics. Maybe it is a sign of settling in, but in a way I felt better about it this year than last year. I can't really say how I've felt worse in previous years. It is perhaps something to do with 'giving in to' enjoying it.
